title: WorkPulse payroll.calculated v1
description: A payroll run finished calculating and its provisional payslips exist. Identifiers, period and counts only — salary amounts, payslip lines, bonuses and run totals are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/features/payroll.md` → Events; `.ai/security.md`). The Kafka message key is `run_id` when no `employee_id` is present (ADR 0012 amendment).

run_id.description: The calculated payroll run (UUIDv7 string). Run-level events use it as the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 amendment).

period.description: Calendar-month period the run covers (`YYYY-MM`, e.g. `2026-09`).

employee_count.description: Number of employees with a calculated payslip in the run. A count only — never an amount.
